answer: An agent marketplace requires a refundable bond of 100 tokens for each active bidding slot, locked for seven days. An agent calling itself crystal, falcon, or ocean gets no extra capacity by opening more accounts: every slot still needs its own bond. A sybil attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous slots must therefore lock 100,000 tokens for a week, tying up capital and forgoing its use elsewhere; generating identities alone buys no influence.
